selection_note: Initial LinkedIn scan for content creator, social content, video producer, YouTube and technical video roles at technology companies or closely adjacent brands in London and Spain. Every retained listing was live in LinkedIn search on 20 November 2026 and its public detail page was inspected.
language_note: Only English-speaking roles were retained. Roles requiring Spanish, French or Italian were excluded. Tomorrow University lists German as optional, not required.

companies.name: SearchApi
companies.category: Developer API and AI search data

jobs.title: Social Content Producer - B2B Experience Required
jobs.fit_note: Exceptional crossover with Phil’s B2B SaaS sales background. The role turns complex SaaS and AI concepts into LinkedIn-first stories for business buyers and expects a hands-on maker who can shoot, edit and design.
jobs.formats: LinkedIn, video, photography, design and B2B storytelling
jobs.language_requirement: English only; no other mandatory language found

jobs.title: Content Creator (UK)
jobs.fit_note: A near-direct match for Phil’s technology, sales and creator ambitions. The role is the on-camera face of a fast-growing B2B AI company, explaining automation in an entertaining, conversion-aware way.
jobs.formats: TikTok, Instagram Reels and on-camera product storytelling
jobs.technology: AI agents, automation and communications SaaS

jobs.title: YouTube Technical Content Creator
jobs.fit_note: Owns an AI-native technology company’s video channel and presents demos, shorts, webinars and long-form YouTube. Strong creator fit; the main stretch is building and confidently explaining working developer demos.
jobs.formats: YouTube Shorts, long-form video, webinars and technical demos
jobs.technology: Search API, AI and developer tools
jobs.language_requirement: Native or C2 English required; no Spanish requirement

jobs.title: Content Creator
jobs.fit_note: Owns social content for an AI company with an impact-led mission. It combines storytelling, video, photography, writing and leadership content with input from sales and the wider business.
jobs.formats: Social video, photography, blogs, paid social and LinkedIn
jobs.language_requirement: English listing; no other mandatory language found

jobs.title: Video Producer
jobs.fit_note: Strong AI and SaaS environment with end-to-end ownership of YouTube, LinkedIn, Reels and paid video. The biggest gap is the stated three years of professional editing experience.
jobs.formats: YouTube tutorials and interviews, LinkedIn clips, Reels and paid ads
jobs.language_requirement: English application and working environment; no Spanish requirement found

jobs.title: Senior Videographer
jobs.fit_note: Creates entertaining, educational and promotional content for a distinctive consumer technology brand. Excellent sector fit, with a higher technical production bar and three-plus years of video experience required.
jobs.formats: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, tutorials, interviews and vertical video
jobs.technology: Consumer gadgets, productivity hardware and apps
jobs.language_requirement: C1 English required; no other mandatory language

jobs.title: Social Video Producer
jobs.fit_note: A strong technology-adjacent creator role producing accurate, entertaining science videos and helping journalists present on camera. Direct editorial video experience is likely the main gap.
jobs.formats: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, podcasts and interviews
jobs.language_requirement: English listing; no other mandatory language found

jobs.title: Junior Video Content & Creative Producer
jobs.fit_note: Remote-first EdTech creator role spanning demand creation and recurring video formats. It is junior, but offers a credible entry into technology content with location flexibility from Spain.
jobs.formats: Video series, YouTube and marketing content
jobs.technology: EdTech, AI-enabled learning and remote education
jobs.language_requirement: English working environment; German is optional, not required

jobs.title: Customer Service Project/Program Manager for Video Shorts
jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
jobs.fit_note: Technology-company role owning strategy and delivery for HP Support YouTube Shorts. Phil’s stakeholder and project skills transfer well, though it manages vendors more than creating every video personally.
jobs.formats: YouTube Shorts and short-form customer support video
jobs.language_requirement: English-related degree accepted; no mandatory Spanish requirement found

jobs.title: Content Producer
jobs.fit_note: Not a technology company, but an unusually strong passion match combining video, YouTube, artists, club nights and social storytelling. It expects confident filming, editing and colour grading in live environments.
jobs.formats: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, interviews, live events and photography
jobs.technology: Digital content production and social platforms
jobs.language_requirement: English listing; no other mandatory language found
